title: Projectile Motion with Gravity
description: Interactive physics simulation demonstrating the effect of adjustable gravity on projectile trajectories. Features controls for varying gravitational acceleration with multiple trajectory visualization for comparison.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Physics
Kinematics
Projectile Motion
Gravity
Parabolic Motion
Mechanics
Gravitational Acceleration
learningObjectives: Explain that gravity accelerates only the vertical component of a projectile's motion, leaving horizontal velocity unchanged
Predict how lowering the gravity slider toward 0 m/s^2 flattens the trajectory and extends the range of a 45-degree shot
Compare trajectories fired at Earth, Moon, and Mars gravity settings using the accumulated dashed traces left on screen
Analyze the inverse relationship between gravitational acceleration and both peak height and horizontal range
Evaluate why a projectile fired with identical power travels much farther on a low-gravity body
